title: Kova theme
description: A Kova theme is data, never code: no CSS, no JavaScript, no URLs. Unknown keys are rejected so a theme cannot smuggle in anything the renderer does not expect. See docs/THEMES.md.

id.description: Stable identifier used by settings and exports. Lowercase, hyphenated.

version.description: Semver. Bumped when the theme's values change.

extends.description: Base theme to inherit from. Override only what you change.

tokens.description: Semantic overrides only. A primitive or component token here is rejected.

background.description: Optional decorative background behind the app shell: a subtle gradient, a fine noise texture or one image from KOVA_HOME/themes/assets. Panels stay readable; text contrast is measured against the surfaces and against the worst-case background area behind them.

terminal.description: Optional 16-role ANSI palette, in order 0-15. Without it the TUI uses the inherited base palette.

color.description: Hex or rgb()/rgba(). No named colours, no CSS functions beyond rgb/rgba, and never a url().

colorGroup.description: A flat group of colour tokens, e.g. { "default": "#ff7a1a", "hover": "#ff9a52" }.

stops.description: Two to four colours, in painting order.

angle.description: CSS gradient angle in degrees. Defaults to 160, a gentle top-to-bottom wash.

opacity.description: How strongly the grain shows, drawn in the theme's fg.default over bg.base. Defaults to 0.06.

file.description: One file name in KOVA_HOME/themes/assets. No paths, URLs or query strings; png, jpg or webp only.

dim.description: How much of the theme's bg.base is laid over the image. Defaults to 0.55.

blur.description: Gaussian blur in CSS pixels. Defaults to 0.
